fact_text: A Bahrain-based group transferred its holding in Faysal Bank to GFH Financial Group, and the analyst says the transfer had no material effect on the share price.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Faysal Bank (FABL) Analysis: Book Value Boost | PSX Update' (YouTube, 2024-07-24)

fact_text: Faysal Bank's book value flow grew at about 28 percent, which the analyst says points to strong book value growth in 2024.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Faysal Bank (FABL) Analysis: Book Value Boost | PSX Update' (YouTube, 2024-07-24)

fact_text: Faysal Bank pays a dividend of about Re 1 each quarter, and the analyst notes that it paid a larger one-off dividend while exiting an earlier earnings-purification process.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Faysal Bank (FABL) Analysis: Book Value Boost | PSX Update' (YouTube, 2024-07-24)

fact_text: Faysal Bank's net interest margin is moving toward about 6 percent, which the analyst says is the level Islamic banks normally show and an important input for pricing the stock.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Faysal Bank (FABL) Analysis: Book Value Boost | PSX Update' (YouTube, 2024-07-24)

fact_text: The analyst says Faysal Bank trades at a price-to-earnings multiple of about 2.7 times, against a forward multiple of about 6 times for the KSE-100 on his estimates, so he sees the stock as cheap.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Faysal Bank (FABL) Analysis: Book Value Boost | PSX Update' (YouTube, 2024-07-24)

fact_text: The analyst says Faysal Bank's branch-led growth and advances growth are less aggressive than Meezan Bank's, which many people criticise and which he treats as a fair point for valuation.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Faysal Bank (FABL) Analysis: Book Value Boost | PSX Update' (YouTube, 2024-07-24)

fact_text: Askari Bank trades at a price-to-book multiple of about 2.3 times, which the analyst calls cheap relative to its deposits and market capitalisation.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Faysal Bank (FABL) Analysis: Book Value Boost | PSX Update' (YouTube, 2024-07-24)

fact_text: Fauji Fertilizer and Fauji Fertilizer Bin Qasim together hold about 65 percent of Askari Bank, which makes Askari Bank important in their merger case.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Faysal Bank (FABL) Analysis: Book Value Boost | PSX Update' (YouTube, 2024-07-24)

fact_text: In the merger of Fauji Fertilizer and Fauji Fertilizer Bin Qasim, about 3.5 FFBL shares equal one FFC share, and the analyst expects FFC to be the surviving entity.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Faysal Bank (FABL) Analysis: Book Value Boost | PSX Update' (YouTube, 2024-07-24)

fact_text: The analyst says the ratios of Fauji Fertilizer and Fauji Fertilizer Bin Qasim look consistent with their current market prices, so he does not see a major risk for investors at these levels.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Faysal Bank (FABL) Analysis: Book Value Boost | PSX Update' (YouTube, 2024-07-24)

fact_text: Fauji Fertilizer Bin Qasim has improved over the past one to two years, as DAP prices rose, and the analyst says this makes it attractive relative to its peers.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Faysal Bank (FABL) Analysis: Book Value Boost | PSX Update' (YouTube, 2024-07-24)

fact_text: The analyst described an exchange ratio of about 3.51 FFBL shares to one FFC share, with Fauji Fertilizer Company expected to be the surviving entity.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Faysal Bank (FABL) Analysis: Book Value Boost | PSX Update' (YouTube, 2024-07-24)
